_dev_notes: DEV NOTE: Registry seal fixture. This file records the v1 registry-seal state used by CI and registry integrity checks.
DEV NOTE: seal_version identifies the registry seal schema/version being represented. Changing it is a registry contract change and must be reviewed deliberately.
DEV NOTE: bundle_hash is UNSEALED until the deterministic registry sealing path writes the canonical bundle hash. Do not hand-edit it to make tests pass.
DEV NOTE: sealed_at is null while the seal is intentionally unsealed. A timestamp should only appear when the seal has been generated through the intended sealing process.
DEV NOTE: registry_count is null while unsealed. A concrete count should come from the registry sealing path, not manual estimation.
DEV NOTE: This file records seal state only. It must not define engine behaviour, registry law, release scope, or product authority.
DEV NOTE: Keep this file strict JSON. Do not add comments, trailing commas, JSONC syntax, or parser-specific extensions.
